label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. E1 is an unchecked national database record of a past accident inside the area; under the national criteria it is a clearance target after the first visit, and technical survey is not available in this programme. E2 is a weaker, second-hand report that does not independently establish a located incident.
flags: The database entry has no date or other detail, and its location has not been verified on the ground; retain this limitation in the sign-off review.
The survey-zone flag and priority are not evidence and were not used as grounds for the recommendation.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: The location and reliability of the database record have not been checked on the ground, so it is indirect evidence and reliability class 6.

E2.quote: A bus driver said neighbours told him that an animal was killed by a mine somewhere in the area some years ago.
E2.note: This is a second-hand report relayed by an informant whose underlying source cannot be identified as first-hand; it suggests possible contamination but does not locate or confirm it.
